findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "consulting_offer" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Returns Emergent's published description of its AI & automation consulting: what it is, how Emergent matches each job with the best-fit specialist, how an engagement runs (Assess, Match, Build, Run), the services, enterprise private intelligence and its deployment options (with a leading lab, on ded" → after: "Returns Emergent's published description of its AI & automation consulting: what it is, how Emergent assesses a business and pairs each initiative with the specialist suited to deliver it, how an engagement runs (Assess, Match, Build, Run), the services, enterprise private intelligence and its deplo"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
